args.lesson: Worked: small per-file EXECs, each under 8 KB. The first combined write was refused for length, which repeats L33, so split from the start. Distinct exit codes (2 absent, 3 API mismatch, 4 fixtures, 1 assertion) and an OVERRIDE_MODULE label stop stub runs from passing as upstream. Stub tests passed 12/12 across preserving, lossy, throwing, no-export and string converters. The real sandbox run exited 2 DEPENDENCY_ABSENT. Limits: the htmlToLexical export name is assumed and guarded by exit 3, transitive deps are unlocked and the Ghost import (Q5) is not covered. Do not reopen it without someone who has the runtime or a pinned image. No demand or revenue. Also: lessons max 1000 chars.
